description: Defines the MediaSource interface for media data sources in Android's stagefright media framework, including methods for starting, stopping, reading data, and managing format and stop time.

classes.name: MediaSource
classes.description: An abstract interface for media data sources, providing methods to control data flow and retrieve media format.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the media source with optional parameters before reading data.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media source and releases held buffers.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the media data output by this source.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer of media data, blocking until data is available or an error/end of stream occurs.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Suspends pulling data from upstream source; default implementation returns ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.

methods.name: setStopTimeUs
methods.description: Sets a timestamp to stop sending buffers; default implementation returns ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.
